```{r}
# ============================================================
# Run dNdScv from pILC WES cohort MAF
# ============================================================

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(dndscv)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# -----------------------------
# Paths
# -----------------------------

base_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON"
maf_file <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/maftools/Tier_1_common/Combined_MAF/Tier_1_common_all_samples.combined.maf"

dndscv_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "dNdScv")
results_dir <- file.path(dndscv_dir, "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


stopifnot(file.exists(maf_file))

message("Input MAF: ", maf_file)
message("Output directory: ", results_dir)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Read MAF
# -----------------------------
# skip = "Hugo_Symbol" handles MAF files with comment/header lines

maf <- fread(
  maf_file,
  sep = "\t",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = "Hugo_Symbol",
  data.table = TRUE,
  showProgress = TRUE
)

message("Total MAF rows: ", nrow(maf))

# -----------------------------
# Check required columns
# -----------------------------

required_cols <- c(
  "Tumor_Sample_Barcode",
  "Chromosome",
  "Start_Position",
  "Reference_Allele",
  "Tumor_Seq_Allele2",
  "Variant_Classification"
)

missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(maf))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop("Missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
}
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Keep coding variants, including Silent
# -----------------------------
# Important:
# dNdScv needs synonymous/Silent mutations to estimate the background mutation rate.

coding_classes <- c(
  "Silent",
  "Missense_Mutation",
  "Nonsense_Mutation",
  "Nonstop_Mutation",
  "Splice_Site",
  "Splice_Region",
  "Translation_Start_Site",
  "Frame_Shift_Del",
  "Frame_Shift_Ins",
  "In_Frame_Del",
  "In_Frame_Ins"
)

maf_coding <- maf[Variant_Classification %in% coding_classes]

message("Rows after coding filter including Silent: ", nrow(maf_coding))
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Optional Variant_Type filter
# -----------------------------
# dNdScv is safest with SNP, INS, DEL.
# Complex multinucleotide variants are excluded and saved separately.

if ("Variant_Type" %in% colnames(maf_coding)) {
  
  maf_excluded_variant_type <- maf_coding[
    !Variant_Type %in% c("SNP", "INS", "DEL")
  ]
  
  fwrite(
    maf_excluded_variant_type,
    file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_excluded_non_SNP_INS_DEL_variants.tsv"),
    sep = "\t"
  )
  
  maf_coding <- maf_coding[Variant_Type %in% c("SNP", "INS", "DEL")]
  
  message("Rows after keeping SNP/INS/DEL: ", nrow(maf_coding))
}
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Prepare dNdScv 5-column input
# -----------------------------

dnds_input <- maf_coding[
  ,
  .(
    sampleID = Tumor_Sample_Barcode,
    chr      = Chromosome,
    pos      = Start_Position,
    ref      = Reference_Allele,
    mut      = Tumor_Seq_Allele2
  )
]

# Clean chromosome format
dnds_input[, chr := gsub("^chr", "", as.character(chr), ignore.case = TRUE)]
dnds_input[, chr := as.character(chr)]

# Keep standard chromosomes
dnds_input <- dnds_input[chr %in% c(as.character(1:22), "X", "Y")]

# Clean alleles
dnds_input[, ref := toupper(as.character(ref))]
dnds_input[, mut := toupper(as.character(mut))]

# Remove incomplete rows
dnds_input <- dnds_input[
  !is.na(sampleID) &
    !is.na(chr) &
    !is.na(pos) &
    !is.na(ref) &
    !is.na(mut) &
    sampleID != "" &
    chr != "" &
    ref != "" &
    mut != "" &
    ref != "." &
    mut != "."
]

# Remove REF == ALT
dnds_input <- dnds_input[ref != mut]

# Remove duplicate mutation records
dnds_input <- unique(dnds_input)

message("Final dNdScv input rows: ", nrow(dnds_input))
message("Number of samples: ", length(unique(dnds_input$sampleID)))

# Save dNdScv input
fwrite(
  dnds_input,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_input_5col.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Save QC summaries
# -----------------------------

qc_variant_class <- maf_coding[
  ,
  .N,
  by = Variant_Classification
][order(-N)]

fwrite(
  qc_variant_class,
  file.path(results_dir, "QC_variant_class_counts_used_for_dNdScv.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

qc_sample_burden <- dnds_input[
  ,
  .N,
  by = sampleID
][order(-N)]

fwrite(
  qc_sample_burden,
  file.path(results_dir, "QC_mutation_count_per_sample_used_for_dNdScv.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Run dNdScv
# -----------------------------
# use refdb = "hg38"

message("Running dNdScv...")

dndsout <- dndscv(
  mutations = as.data.frame(dnds_input),
  refdb = "hg38",
  outmats = TRUE
)

message("dNdScv finished.")

# Save full R object
saveRDS(
  dndsout,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_output_object.rds")
)

# -----------------------------
# Export main output tables
# -----------------------------

sel_cv <- as.data.table(dndsout$sel_cv)

fwrite(
  sel_cv,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_gene_selection_results_sel_cv.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

global_dnds <- as.data.table(
  dndsout$globaldnds,
  keep.rownames = "category"
)

fwrite(
  global_dnds,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_global_dnds.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

annotmuts <- as.data.table(dndsout$annotmuts)

fwrite(
  annotmuts,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_annotated_mutations.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

genemuts <- as.data.table(dndsout$genemuts)

fwrite(
  genemuts,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_gene_observed_expected_mutations.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Significant driver candidates
# -----------------------------

sig_q10 <- sel_cv[
  (!is.na(qglobal_cv) & qglobal_cv < 0.10) |
    (!is.na(qallsubs_cv) & qallsubs_cv < 0.10)
][order(qglobal_cv, qallsubs_cv)]

fwrite(
  sig_q10,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_significant_genes_q_lt_0.10.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

sig_q05 <- sel_cv[
  (!is.na(qglobal_cv) & qglobal_cv < 0.05) |
    (!is.na(qallsubs_cv) & qallsubs_cv < 0.05)
][order(qglobal_cv, qallsubs_cv)]

fwrite(
  sig_q05,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_significant_genes_q_lt_0.05.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)
```


```{r}
# -----------------------------
# Confidence intervals
# -----------------------------

message("Calculating gene-level confidence intervals...")

ci <- geneci(dndsout)

ci_dt <- as.data.table(
  ci,
  keep.rownames = "gene_name"
)

fwrite(
  ci_dt,
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_gene_dnds_confidence_intervals.tsv"),
  sep = "\t"
)

# -----------------------------
# Plot all significant genes
# -----------------------------

plot_dt <- copy(sel_cv)

# Keep genes significant by either global or substitution-only test
plot_dt <- plot_dt[
  (!is.na(qglobal_cv) & qglobal_cv < 0.05) |
    (!is.na(qallsubs_cv) & qallsubs_cv < 0.05)
]

# Use the best available q-value for plotting
plot_dt[
  ,
  q_for_plot := pmin(
    fifelse(is.na(qglobal_cv), Inf, qglobal_cv),
    fifelse(is.na(qallsubs_cv), Inf, qallsubs_cv)
  )
]

plot_dt <- plot_dt[
  is.finite(q_for_plot) & !is.na(q_for_plot)
][order(q_for_plot)]

plot_dt[, neglog10q := -log10(q_for_plot)]

# Keep all genes, ordered by significance
plot_dt[, gene_name := factor(gene_name, levels = rev(gene_name))]

# Create plot object
p_all36 <- ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = gene_name, y = neglog10q)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Significant candidate driver genes by dNdScv",
    subtitle = "Genes significant by global or substitution-only test",
    x = "Gene",
    y = "-log10(best q-value)"
  )

print(p_all36)

# Save PDF
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_all_significant_driver_genes.pdf"),
  plot = p_all36,
  width = 8,
  height = 10
)

# Save PNG
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_all_significant_driver_genes.png"),
  plot = p_all36,
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)

message("All dNdScv outputs saved to:")
message(results_dir)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# dNdScv visualization: bubble cloud + evidence comparison
# ============================================================

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

results_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/dNdScv/results/"

sel_cv <- fread(file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_gene_selection_results_sel_cv.tsv"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Helper columns
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sel_cv[, total_events := n_mis + n_non + n_spl + n_ind]

sel_cv[, trunc_splice := n_non + n_spl]

sel_cv[, evidence_group := fifelse(
  !is.na(qglobal_cv) & qglobal_cv < 0.05 &
    !is.na(qallsubs_cv) & qallsubs_cv < 0.05,
  "Both",
  fifelse(
    !is.na(qglobal_cv) & qglobal_cv < 0.05,
    "Global only",
    fifelse(
      !is.na(qallsubs_cv) & qallsubs_cv < 0.05,
      "Substitution only",
      "Not significant"
    )
  )
)]

sel_cv[, dominant_signal := fifelse(
  n_ind >= pmax(n_mis, trunc_splice),
  "Indel-dominant",
  fifelse(
    n_mis >= pmax(trunc_splice, n_ind),
    "Missense-dominant",
    "Trunc/splice-dominant"
  )
)]

dominant_signal_colors <- c(
  "Missense-dominant"     = "#1F78B4",  # blue
  "Trunc/splice-dominant" = "#E31A1C",  # red
  "Indel-dominant"        = "#6A3D9A"   # purple
)

evidence_group_colors <- c(
  "Both"              = "#1B9E77",  # green
  "Global only"       = "#D95F02",  # orange
  "Substitution only" = "#7570B3",  # violet
  "Not significant"   = "grey70"
)

sel_cv[, dominant_signal := factor(
  dominant_signal,
  levels = c(
    "Missense-dominant",
    "Trunc/splice-dominant",
    "Indel-dominant"
  )
)]

sel_cv[, evidence_group := factor(
  evidence_group,
  levels = c(
    "Both",
    "Global only",
    "Substitution only",
    "Not significant"
  )
)]

# ============================================================
# Plot 1: Bubble cloud of genes with qglobal_cv < 0.05
# Bubble cloud of global significant genes
# x-axis      = -log10(qglobal_cv)
# y-axis      = gene name
# bubble size = total selected mutations
# bubble color = dominant signal type
# ============================================================

plot_dt <- sel_cv[
  !is.na(qglobal_cv) & qglobal_cv < 0.05
][order(qglobal_cv)]

plot_dt[, neglog10_qglobal := -log10(pmax(qglobal_cv, .Machine$double.xmin))]

plot_dt[, gene_name := factor(
  gene_name,
  levels = rev(plot_dt$gene_name)
)]

p1 <- ggplot(plot_dt, aes(
  x = neglog10_qglobal,
  y = gene_name,
  size = total_events,
  color = dominant_signal
)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = dominant_signal_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(3, 10)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "dNdScv candidate driver genes",
    subtitle = "Primary analysis: global combined test (qglobal_cv < 0.05)",
    x = expression(-log[10](qglobal_cv)),
    y = "Gene",
    size = "Total events",
    color = "Dominant signal"
  )

print(p1)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_bubble_cloud_qglobal_lt_0.05.pdf"),
  plot = p1,
  width = 9,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_bubble_cloud_qglobal_lt_0.05.png"),
  plot = p1,
  width = 9,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)

# ============================================================
# Plot 2: qglobal_cv vs qallsubs_cv comparison
# Comparison plot show which genes are significant in both- substitution-only vs global-only
# x-axis = -log10(qallsubs_cv)
# y-axis = -log10(qglobal_cv)
# ============================================================

plot2_dt <- sel_cv[
  !is.na(qglobal_cv) & !is.na(qallsubs_cv)
]

plot2_dt[, neglog10_qglobal := -log10(pmax(qglobal_cv, .Machine$double.xmin))]
plot2_dt[, neglog10_qallsubs := -log10(pmax(qallsubs_cv, .Machine$double.xmin))]

sig_cutoff <- -log10(0.05)

# Label only genes significant in BOTH qglobal_cv and qallsubs_cv
both_label_dt <- plot2_dt[
  evidence_group == "Both"
]

p2 <- ggplot(plot2_dt, aes(
  x = neglog10_qglobal,
  y = neglog10_qallsubs,
  color = evidence_group
)) +
  geom_point(
    aes(size = total_events),
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = sig_cutoff,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = sig_cutoff,
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = both_label_dt,
    aes(label = gene_name),
    color = "black",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 3.3,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.3,
    min.segment.length = 0,
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    seed = 42,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = evidence_group_colors,
    drop = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_size_continuous(
    range = c(2, 8)
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of global and substitution-specific dNdScv evidence",
    subtitle = "Dashed lines indicate q-value threshold of 0.05",
    x = expression(-log[10](qglobal_cv)),
    y = expression(-log[10](qallsubs_cv)),
    color = "Evidence group",
    size = "Total events"
  )

print(p2)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_qglobal_vs_qallsubs_comparison.pdf"),
  plot = p2,
  width = 8,
  height = 7
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_qglobal_vs_qallsubs_comparison.png"),
  plot = p2,
  width = 8,
  height = 7,
  dpi = 300
)
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Word clouds for dNdScv results
# 1) qglobal_cv < 0.05
# 2) qallsubs_cv < 0.05
# ============================================================

library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggwordcloud)
library(scales)

# -----------------------------
# Input
# -----------------------------
results_dir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/Compare_TumorOnly_vs_WithPON/dNdScv/results/"

sel_cv <- fread(
  file.path(results_dir, "dNdScv_gene_selection_results_sel_cv.tsv")
)

# -----------------------------
# Helper columns
# -----------------------------
sel_cv[, total_events := n_mis + n_non + n_spl + n_ind]
sel_cv[, total_subs_events := n_mis + n_non + n_spl]

# ============================================================
# Function to create word cloud
# ============================================================
make_dndscv_wordcloud <- function(
    dt,
    q_col,
    q_label,
    burden_col,
    subtitle_text,
    out_prefix,
    width = 10,
    height = 7
) {
  
  # Filter significant genes
  plot_dt <- dt[
    !is.na(get(q_col)) & get(q_col) < 0.05
  ][order(get(q_col))]
  
  if (nrow(plot_dt) == 0) {
    message("No significant genes found for ", q_col, ". Skipping word cloud.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Combined weight:
  # larger words = stronger significance + higher mutation burden
  plot_dt[, weight_plot_raw := (-log10(get(q_col))) * log2(get(burden_col) + 1)]
  
  # Rescale for better display
  plot_dt[, weight_plot := rescale(weight_plot_raw, to = c(6, 22))]
  
  # Unique color per gene
  gene_colors <- setNames(
    hcl.colors(nrow(plot_dt), palette = "Dynamic"),
    plot_dt$gene_name
  )
  
  # Plot
  p_wc <- ggplot(
    plot_dt,
    aes(
      label = gene_name,
      size = weight_plot,
      color = gene_name
    )
  ) +
    geom_text_wordcloud_area(
      rm_outside = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_size_area(max_size = 20) +
    scale_color_manual(values = gene_colors) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "dNdScv Candidate Driver Genes",
      subtitle = subtitle_text
    )
  
  print(p_wc)
  
  # Save PNG
  ggsave(
    file.path(results_dir, paste0(out_prefix, ".png")),
    plot = p_wc,
    width = width,
    height = height,
    dpi = 300
  )
  
  # Save PDF
  ggsave(
    file.path(results_dir, paste0(out_prefix, ".pdf")),
    plot = p_wc,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  
  return(p_wc)
}

# ============================================================
# Word cloud 1: qglobal_cv < 0.05
# Word size reflects global significance + total mutation burden
# ============================================================
p_wc_qglobal <- make_dndscv_wordcloud(
  dt = sel_cv,
  q_col = "qglobal_cv",
  q_label = "qglobal_cv",
  burden_col = "total_events",
  subtitle_text = "Word size reflects global significance and total mutation burden",
  out_prefix = "dNdScv_wordcloud_gene_colored_qglobal_lt_0.05"
)

# ============================================================
# Word cloud 2: qallsubs_cv < 0.05
# Word size reflects substitution significance + substitution burden
# ============================================================
p_wc_qallsubs <- make_dndscv_wordcloud(
  dt = sel_cv,
  q_col = "qallsubs_cv",
  q_label = "qallsubs_cv",
  burden_col = "total_subs_events",
  subtitle_text = "Word size reflects substitution-specific significance and substitution burden",
  out_prefix = "dNdScv_wordcloud_gene_colored_qallsubs_lt_0.05"
)
```
